_comment: Trusted-source registry for soccer_x_monitor.py. Editable by hand - add/remove accounts as you verify them. trust_tier: 1=official club/league, 2=established beat reporter, 3=established soccer news outlet, 4=aggregator, 5=unknown/unverified. Seeded with placeholder examples only (not verified live X accounts) - fill in real handles you trust before enabling live monitoring. Entries with trust_tier 5 are effectively 'discovery only' - see soccer_x_monitor.TRUST_TIER_WEIGHT.
